notes.title: Gravity Escape is out now
notes.notes:
Gravity Escape is now available!
Pick up your gravity gun and let's escape this planet together!
If you encounter any issues, feel free to join our Discord and share your feedback with the developer.
Thank you!

notes.title: New Demo version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We have updated the trial version of Gravity Escape, addressing some issues and adjusting the level configurations. 
Players who are interested can give it another try. 
We plan to release the full version in the first quarter of next year. 
Please be patient and stay tuned.
Thank you!
